info.name: CivicPulse API
info.description:
Authentication, issue reporting, issue workflow, dashboard and admin endpoints for the CivicPulse backend.

Tokens are issued as HttpOnly cookies, so Postman handles authentication automatically after a login request. Run the folders in order: Auth, Public Issues, Citizen, Admin, Personnel, Cleanup. Logins are kept to one per role switch because each login replaces the active cookie session.

Register and create-issue each have two variants. Use the raw JSON request when there is no file. To send a file, use the multipart request: one text field named `body` holding the JSON object, plus a File field named `image`. Example body value: {"name":"Ayesha Rahman","email":"{{registerEmail}}","password":"Str0ngPass1"}.

Registration is two steps: the register request emails a 6-digit OTP, then `Verify email (OTP)` creates the account. In development the OTP is printed in the API console; paste it into the `otp` collection variable first. registerEmail uses {{$timestamp}} so re-runs do not collide.

Images go to Cloudinary as multipart `image` files, max 5 MB (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF): profile photo at PATCH /api/auth/me/image and removed at DELETE /api/auth/me/image, issue photo at PATCH /api/issues/:id/image, and admin-managed user photos at PATCH/DELETE /api/admin/users/:id/image.

Folders after Auth reuse the `userId`, `issueId` and `personnelId` set by earlier requests, so run top to bottom for a full green run.

Set `baseUrl` in the collection variables (default http://localhost:5000).

variable.description: Unique per run. Uses the Postman {{$timestamp}} dynamic variable so re-running Register does not hit 409 Already exists. Override with your own address if you want to receive the real OTP email.

request.description: Multipart register: the whole account object goes in one text field named `body` as JSON, and the optional picture is a File field named `image` (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, max 5 MB). Drop the `image` row to register without a photo. The photo uploads to Cloudinary and is attached to the account when the OTP is verified.

item.name: Verify email (OTP)
item.description: Copy the 6-digit code from the API console (development) or email, set the `otp` collection variable, then send.

request.description: Logs in as the account created by the registration flow above. Requires the OTP in the `otp` variable to be correct.
Returns the current profile, including `imageUrl` (null until a photo is uploaded).

Select a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF file (max 5 MB) in the `image` form-data field. Works for every logged-in role and replaces the previous photo. The file is uploaded to Cloudinary and the secure URL is stored in `imageUrl`.
Removes the current profile photo and returns the updated profile with `imageUrl` set to null.

item.name: Change password

request.description: Changes the currently logged-in account password and revokes all sessions. Adjust the body before running this request.

item.description: Changes the password of the newly registered test account only, so demo accounts are never modified.

request.description: Multipart issue report: the issue fields go in one text field named `body` as JSON, and the optional photo is a File field named `image` (max 5 MB). Drop the `image` row to report without a photo.

Select a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF file (max 5 MB) in the `image` form-data field. The file is uploaded to Cloudinary and the returned secure URL is saved on the issue. Owners can change photos only while the issue is pending; admins can change any issue photo.

request.description: Admin replaces any user's Cloudinary photo. Send a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF file (max 5 MB) in the `image` field. Targets the account created in the Auth folder via the `userId` variable.
Admin clears `imageUrl` and deletes the file from Cloudinary.
